name: gearvane-monorepo
description: GearVane: route each task to the cheapest model tier that can do the job

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @gearvane/core && npm run build --workspace @gearvane/harness && npm run build --workspace @gearvane/app-core && npm run build --workspace @gearvane/cli && npm run build --workspace gearvane && npm run build --workspace gearvane-app
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:repo && npm run test:python
